comment: Orchestration source of truth for the Year 2 Applied (Statistics + Mechanics) bank build. Drives scripts/build-applied-banks.js. status: pending -> generated -> checked -> expanded -> done. boards values gate board-specific generation order; topics.ts itself carries no board field.

subtopics.title: Large Data Sets & Data in Context
subtopics.scope: Variable types (categorical/discrete/continuous/paired bivariate/grouped); missing values, errors, outliers; interpreting summary statistics and diagrams; sampling from a large data set; commenting on sample/diagram limitations. Dataset-agnostic — test reasoning, not memorised dataset facts.

subtopics.title: Conditional Probability
subtopics.scope: P(A|B)=P(A∩B)/P(B); multiplication rule; tree diagrams, Venn diagrams, two-way tables; testing independence; working backwards from a conditional probability to an unknown; critiquing independence/random-sampling assumptions.

subtopics.title: Correlation, Regression & Bivariate Data
subtopics.scope: PMCC r with -1<=r<=1; explanatory vs response variables; regression line y=a+bx; interpolation vs extrapolation (label which); linearising y=ax^n => log y=log a + n log x and y=kb^x => log y=log k + x log b; correlation does not imply causation.

subtopics.title: The Binomial Distribution (Y2)
subtopics.scope: X~B(n,p), P(X=r)=C(n,r)p^r(1-p)^(n-r); cumulative probabilities; the four assumptions (fixed n, two outcomes, independent trials, constant p).

subtopics.title: The Normal Distribution
subtopics.scope: X~N(mu,sigma^2); standardisation Z=(X-mu)/sigma; P(X<a), P(X>a), P(a<X<b); inverse Normal for a boundary value; simultaneous equations for mu,sigma from two probability statements; points of inflection at mu±sigma; commenting on suitability.

subtopics.title: Normal Approximation to the Binomial
subtopics.scope: B(n,p)≈N(np, np(1-p)) for large n, p near 0.5; continuity correction (e.g. P(X<=20)->P(Y<20.5), P(X>=20)->P(Y>19.5)).

subtopics.title: Hypothesis Test — Binomial Proportion
subtopics.scope: X~B(n,p); H0:p=p0 with one- and two-tailed H1; critical-region and p-value methods; full framework (define parameter, state H0/H1, significance level, test statistic, compare, conclude in context).

subtopics.title: Hypothesis Test — Normal Mean
subtopics.scope: Xbar~N(mu, sigma^2/n); Z=(Xbar-mu0)/(sigma/sqrt(n)); variance known/given/assumed; hypotheses in terms of mu.

subtopics.title: Hypothesis Test — Correlation
subtopics.scope: Hypotheses in population rho: H0:rho=0, H1:rho>0,<0,!=0; observed r as the test statistic; critical value or p-value given; safe conclusion wording (insufficient evidence to reject H0).

subtopics.title: Continuous Uniform Distribution
subtopics.scope: X~U(a,b), P(c<X<d)=(d-c)/(b-a) for a<=c<d<=b; mean/variance where required; choosing it within a distribution-selection question.

subtopics.title: The Poisson Distribution
subtopics.scope: X~Po(lambda), P(X=r)=e^(-lambda) lambda^r / r!; distribution selection among binomial/Poisson/uniform/Normal.

subtopics.title: Kinematics — Constant Acceleration
subtopics.scope: 1D suvat (v=u+at, s=ut+1/2 at^2, s=1/2(u+v)t, v^2=u^2+2as) and 2D vector forms v=u+at, r=ut+1/2 at^2; distance vs displacement, speed vs velocity.

subtopics.title: Kinematics — Variable Acceleration
subtopics.scope: v=dr/dt, a=dv/dt; integrate a->v->r with a vector constant at each stage from initial conditions; 1D and 2D vector kinematics.

subtopics.title: Projectile Motion
subtopics.scope: Resolve u_x=u cos theta, u_y=u sin theta; x=(u cos theta)t, y=(u sin theta)t - 1/2 g t^2; velocity components, speed, direction tan phi=v_y/v_x; derive T, H, R (level) and adapt for unequal heights; equation of path; critique ignoring air resistance. Discourage blind formula quoting.

subtopics.title: Forces, Newton's Laws & Resolving
subtopics.scope: Three laws; sum F = m a; resolving on an inclined plane (mg sin theta down-slope, mg cos theta perpendicular); R=mg cos theta only when no other perpendicular force.

subtopics.title: Equilibrium
subtopics.scope: sum F = 0; resolve in two independent directions; particles under several forces; inclined-plane equilibrium.

subtopics.title: Friction
subtopics.scope: Coulomb model F<=mu R; limiting/sliding F=mu R; friction opposes actual or impending motion; combine with resolving and inclined planes.

subtopics.title: Connected Particles & Pulleys (Y2)
subtopics.scope: System view: separate force diagram per particle; common acceleration magnitude (light inextensible string), common tension (smooth pulley); F=ma per particle; solve simultaneously. Contexts: two over a pulley, table+hanging mass, incline+mass, lift/particles in contact.

subtopics.title: Moments
subtopics.scope: moment = force × perpendicular distance; rigid-body equilibrium (sum clockwise = sum anticlockwise, plus sum Fx=sum Fy=0); uniform/non-uniform rods & beams, ladders (with friction), centre of mass, body about to tilt (a reaction = 0). Take moments about an unknown force's point of action.

subtopics.title: Impulse & Momentum
subtopics.scope: p=mv; impulse J=mv-mu=F dt; conservation of momentum sum m u = sum m v in collisions with no external impulse.
